inputs.name: moduleCategoryFindings.structure
inputs.description: Repository structure snapshot supplied to the audit, with a root, discovered files and directories, and optionally declared module source folders. A falsy root makes moduleCategoryFindings return no findings; auditHarnessStructure uses files and dirs, and a missing moduleSourceFolders list behaves as empty.

inputs.name: auditHarnessStructure.structure
inputs.description: Repository structure snapshot supplied to the audit, with a root, discovered files and directories, and optionally declared module source folders. A falsy root makes moduleCategoryFindings return no findings; auditHarnessStructure uses files and dirs, and a missing moduleSourceFolders list behaves as empty.

outputs.name: moduleCategoryFindings
outputs.description: Array of findings for source-like files under the loaded repository root that are neither in a declared module group nor recognized as preserved or legacy forwarding entries. Each finding contains the input path, the module-category-folder rule, and placement guidance; missing root/config or no violations yields an empty array.

examples.message: Place this implementation in a declared responsibility category folder; use harness generate --group <category>.

outputs.name: auditHarnessStructure
outputs.description: Array of findings for violations detected in planning artifacts, folder names, source/test/database layouts, root TypeScript files, module categories, and feature-spec paths. Each finding contains the offending path, a rule identifier, and a corrective message; accepted paths and folders are omitted.

examples.message: Folder "BadFolder" should use lowercase kebab-case or a SvelteKit route segment.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: A synchronous read can throw when a legacy entry is inspected for forwarding behavior and its source path is missing or unreadable.
